dg-APL-250906.title: Aquaforest AF Purify (50 mL)
dg-APL-250906.summary: Aquaforest AF Purify, a freshwater-only treatment that supports fish immunity during bacterial, fungal and single-celled parasite infections.
rows: 10 mL per 100 L in a quarantine tank, for 7–14 days
After 3 days change 20% of the water and add 5 mL per 100 L; repeat twice more
Change 50% of the water and run carbon
notes: Aerate the water during treatment.
warn: Strong dye: can stain decorations, gravel and equipment.
Do not mix with chlorine or oxygen products.

dg-APL-250882.title: Aquaforest AF Shrimp GH+ (125 mL)
dg-APL-250882.summary: Aquaforest AF Shrimp GH+, a liquid mineral mix that raises GH (not KH) in RO/DI water for shrimp molting and breeding.
rows: 3 mL per 5 L of RO, DI or distilled water gives about GH 5
notes: Mix into the water before adding it to the tank; it is ready right away.
Some mineral sediment in the bottle is normal.

dg-APL-250884.title: Aquaforest AF Water Conditioner (125 mL)
dg-APL-250884.summary: Aquaforest AF Water Conditioner, a tap-water treatment that removes chlorine and binds heavy metals, with B vitamins and protective colloids.
rows: 10 mL per 100 L of tap water
Protective colloids and B vitamins for stressed fish
Room temperature, out of sunlight, tightly closed

dg-APL-250878.title: Aquaforest AF Purifying Resin (125 mL)
dg-APL-250878.summary: Aquaforest AF Purifying Resin, an ion-exchange resin for freshwater tanks that pulls out nitrate and other nitrogen compounds to help keep algae down.
rows: Fine mesh bag in a filter basket with steady flow
About 6 hours in 50% bleach, rinse well, soak 24 hours in clean water

dg-APL-250886.title: Aquaforest AF Anti Phosphate Freshwater (1000 mL Bag)
dg-APL-250886.summary: Aquaforest AF Anti Phosphate for freshwater, a media that adsorbs phosphate to help control cyanobacteria and red algae.
rows: Lightly planted, heavily stocked and Malawi/Tanganyika tanks

dg-APL-250887.title: Aquaforest AF Carbon Freshwater (1000 mL Bag)
dg-APL-250887.summary: Aquaforest AF Carbon for freshwater, a steam-activated granular carbon for short polishing runs that won't leach phosphate.
notes: Not for long-term use: carbon also strips essential elements.

dg-APL-250888.title: Aquaforest AF Zeolith Freshwater (1000 mL Bag)
dg-APL-250888.summary: Aquaforest AF Zeolith for freshwater, a zeolite blend that adsorbs ammonia, ammonium, phenols and heavy metals.
warn: Use carefully: too much zeolite can strip nutrients, so planted tanks may need more fertilizer.

dg-APL-207445.title: Red Sea 500 mL Reef Foundation B (Alk)
dg-APL-207445.summary: Red Sea Reef Foundation B, the alkalinity (carbonate) part of Red Sea's Foundation A/B/C program for calcium, alkalinity and magnesium.
rows: 1 mL raises 25 gal by 0.036 meq/L (0.1 dKH)
Foundation A = calcium/strontium, B = alkalinity, C = magnesium

dg-APL-205108.title: Salifert pH Aquarium Test Kit
dg-APL-205108.summary: A Salifert pH test kit for reef tanks with easy-to-read color results.

dg-APL-205105.title: Salifert Nitrite Aquarium Test Kit
dg-APL-205105.summary: A Salifert nitrite test kit for saltwater tanks with easy-to-read color results.

dg-APL-208510.title: OXO Coral Dip Silicone Strainer Good Grips
dg-APL-208510.summary: An OXO silicone steamer basket with long handles, handy for dipping corals without getting your hands wet.

dg-APL-300621.title: Coral Rx Pro Concentrated Coral Dip - 1 oz
dg-APL-300621.summary: Coral Rx Pro, a concentrated coral dip that you dilute in tank water to knock pests and bacterial infections off new corals.
rows: 30 drops (1/3 tsp) per 1 gal (3.8 L) of tank saltwater
warn: Dip only; never add it directly to the aquarium.

dg-APL-300623.title: One Shot Single-Use Coral Dip
dg-APL-300623.summary: A single-use 1 mL Coral Rx vial that makes one gallon of dip for knocking pests and hitchhikers off new corals.
rows: Whole packet in 1 gal of tank water
5–10 minutes, shaking the coral, then rinse in clean saltwater
AEFW, Montipora-eating nudibranchs, bristleworms, zoanthid-eating spiders, red flatworms
Distilled water and a proprietary blend of natural extracts
inBox: 1 × 1 mL Coral Rx One Shot packet
warn: Dip only; never add it directly to the aquarium.

dg-APL-255062.title: PolypLab Reef Primer Coral Conditioner Dip
dg-APL-255062.summary: PolypLab Reef Primer, a gentle potassium-salt coral dip that clears common coral pests before new corals go in the tank.
rows: 45 g (8 capfuls) per 1 gal (4 L) of tank water
Up to 5 minutes, keeping the water moving
Zoanthid- and Montipora-eating nudibranchs, AEFW, bristleworms, zoanthid spiders, red flatworms, hair algae
warn: Dip only; never add to the aquarium. Can irritate skin, eyes and lungs; use with ventilation and wash hands.

dg-APL-255061.title: PolypLab Reef Primer Shot Coral Conditioner Dip
dg-APL-255061.summary: PolypLab Reef Primer, a gentle potassium-salt coral dip that clears common coral pests before new corals go in the tank.
rows: 45 g (8 capfuls) per 1 gal (4 L) of tank water
Up to 5 minutes, keeping the water moving
Zoanthid- and Montipora-eating nudibranchs, AEFW, bristleworms, zoanthid spiders, red flatworms, hair algae
warn: Dip only; never add to the aquarium. Can irritate skin, eyes and lungs; use with ventilation and wash hands.

dg-APL-255064.title: PolypLab Reef Primer One Shot Coral Dip (1 Pouch)
dg-APL-255064.summary: PolypLab Reef Primer, a gentle potassium-salt coral dip that clears common coral pests before new corals go in the tank.
rows: 1 pouch per 1/4 gal (1 L) of tank water
Up to 5 minutes, keeping the water moving
Zoanthid- and Montipora-eating nudibranchs, AEFW, bristleworms, zoanthid spiders, red flatworms, hair algae
inBox: 9 g pouch Reef Primer coral dip
warn: Dip only; never add to the aquarium. Can irritate skin, eyes and lungs; use with ventilation and wash hands.

dg-APL-251738.title: Aquaforest AF Protect Dip (10 mL)
dg-APL-251738.summary: Aquaforest Protect Dip, an iodine-free disinfecting bath for cleaning new or ailing corals before they go in the tank.
rows: Up to 5 minutes; brush or rinse the coral surface, then rinse in clean saltwater
SPS and LPS corals, quarantine or new additions
notes: Shake before use.
warn: Single use: discard the solution and never pour it into the aquarium.

dg-APL-255289.title: AquaZen Pest Snail Catcher & Remover
dg-APL-255289.summary: A reusable trap on a telescoping handle for catching and lifting pest snails off the glass without chemicals.
rows: Traps and removes snails from the glass

dg-APL-208491.title: OXO 5 Quart Coral Dipping Bowl
dg-APL-208491.summary: A 5-quart OXO mixing bowl with a non-slip base and handle, handy for dipping corals.

dg-APL-209269.title: Brightwell Aquatics MediCoral Coral Dip 30ml
dg-APL-209269.summary: Brightwell MediCoral, an antibiotic-free coral dip that gently oxidizes damaged tissue and discourages infection in new or injured corals.
rows: 1 mL (about 20 drops) per 1 US gal of seasoned tank saltwater
SPS 7–10 min; LPS 6–9 min; soft (leather) corals 8–11 min; polyps 5–8 min
No antibiotics or heavy metals (not a medication)
notes: Discard the solution after use.

dg-APL-251452.title: Aquaforest AF Easy Gloss (200mL)
dg-APL-251452.summary: Aquaforest Easy Gloss, a lavender-scented spray that cuts grease and limescale on tank glass and is safe around fish and coral.
rows: Fish and coral safe; does not affect water parameters

dg-APL-253069.title: Seachem Neutral Regulator (250 g)
dg-APL-253069.summary: Seachem Neutral Regulator, a powder that sets and holds freshwater pH at 7.0 while softening water and removing chlorine and chloramine.
rows: Brings high or low pH to neutral (7.0) and holds it
5 g (1 level tsp) per 40–80 L (10–20 gal), once or twice a month
notes: Best dissolved into new or replacement water.

dg-APL-253071.title: Seachem Betta Basics (60 mL)
dg-APL-253071.summary: Seachem Betta Basics, a conditioner that removes chlorine and chloramine, detoxifies ammonia and buffers betta water to pH 7.0.
rows: 1 capful (5 mL) per 1.25 L; betta-only bowls without plants, 1 capful per 4 L (1 gal)
Each water change, and ideally 2–3 times a week

dg-APL-255492.title: Aquaforest AF Minus pH (250 mL)
dg-APL-255492.summary: Aquaforest Minus pH, a phosphate-free conditioner that lowers the pH of tap water for fish that need softer, more acidic water.
rows: 1 mL per 1 L lowers pH by 0.2
Treat change water outside the tank, after testing its pH
warn: Do not dose into the aquarium, and do not drop tank pH more than 0.5 per day.

dg-APL-211359.title: ReefHD Reef Flux Fluconazole Treatment
dg-APL-211359.summary: ReefHD Reef Flux, a fluconazole treatment for certain fungal fish infections that is also very hard on bryopsis algae.
rows: 1 capsule per 10 gal (20 mg/gal) into a high-flow area of the sump
Skimmer off for the first 3 days; remove carbon and chemical media (GFO/Phosban can stay)
At least a 30% water change after 14 days
warn: Do not overdose. Avoid in tanks with Caulerpa/Bryopsis refugiums to prevent nutrient spikes. Not for fish meant for human consumption.

dg-APL-252632.title: Endich 16 oz Copper Power Green
dg-APL-252632.summary: Endich Copper Power Green, a chelated copper treatment for ich, fungus and external parasites in freshwater tanks that stays active for months.
rows: 1 fl oz per 20 gal (0.625 ppm copper)
2 fl oz per 20 gal (1.25 ppm copper)
2 fl oz in 5 gal for 10 minutes
Not removed by carbon; safe with live plants
warn: Do not use with snails, shrimp or other invertebrates. Freshwater only.
